headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Tight Security For SI Preliminary Examination.
12 Injured In Rabid Dog Attack In Satya Sai district.
MPDO suspended for failing to provide food to election staff in Polavaram district.
Rebels As Independents May Affect Prospects Of Alliance Candidates In Kakinada.
bullets_ur: SI Preliminary Examination ke liye sakht sikhayi ka intezam.
Satya Sai district mein awara kuttay ke hamlay mein 12 log zakhmi.
Polavaram district mein election staff ko khana na dene par MPDO muattal.
Kakinada mein baaghi independents ke tor par kharay honay se alliance candidates ke imkanat mutasir ho saktay hain.
